description: One of the signed-in customer's companies as it stands on its register: legal and former name, entity type, registration numbers, incorporation date, registered and business address, nature of business (MSIC codes), financial year end, whether it has a constitution, its share capital by class, and its company secretary, auditor and tax agent. For directors and shareholders use get_company_registers.
name: get_company_particulars
title: Get a company's particulars
